workflow: The room was bright and airy, with white-washed walls and large windows that bathed the area in light. In the center was a large, wooden desk, covered in papers and books that gave a sense of productivity. An old, velvet armchair sat in the corner, its vibrant colors looking out of place. On the walls hung abstract paintings, each expressing the personality of the room. In the corner, an old record player was spinning a vinyl, the sound filling the air with a soft, calming melody.
